favourite.heading: Why UCLA can pull away
bullets: UCLA is the better football team by 7.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+7.4 pts).
Playing at UCLA is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Purdue can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Purdue by 0.8 points: ball control vs front disruption (-0.8 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -12.2 to p90 +31.8 for UCLA, so a projection of +10.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 3.7 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
